import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int best_a = 0, best_b = 1;
        double best_diff = 1e100;
        for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            long num = (long)x * b;
            int a0 = (int)(num / y);
            for (int a : new int[]{a0, a0 + 1}) {
                double diff = Math.abs((double)a / b - (double)x / y);
                if (diff < best_diff) {
                    best_diff = diff;
                    best_a = a;
                    best_b = b;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(best_a + "/" + best_b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
